introHtml: Gray wine stoppers offer a neutral, sophisticated look that complements any wine bottle or gift set. Whether you are outfitting a corporate event with branded accessories or creating a cohesive set of welcome gifts for hotel guests, gray pairs well with metallic or foil imprint colors for a subtle yet polished brand presence. Choose from stainless steel or silicone stoppers with your logo engraved or printed in one or two colors.
